findings.detail: The 2029 iHeartCommunications bond has a source interest rate of 9.13%, but the extracted interest_rate is blank.
The 2030 iHeartCommunications bond has a source interest rate of 10.88%, but the extracted interest_rate is blank.

rationale: Class 2 review of the two flagged private-credit rows. The March 31, 2026 schedule explicitly reports 9.13% and 10.88% in the Interest Rate column for the matching iHeartCommunications bonds, while both extracted rows have blank interest_rate and basis_spread. The X02 flags therefore identify real source-to-extract omissions.
